living_cost_source_basis.description: TU Delft's own tuition/finances page explicitly declines to estimate living costs for EU/EFTA students and refers applicants to the Study in NL website instead.

TU Delft does not publish a separate genuine cost-of-living estimate for non-EU/EEA students distinct from the IND proof-of-funds requirement; that figure is now represented exclusively as a FinancialRequirement record (nl-tu-delft-finreq-ind-proof-of-funds), per V1.2's narrowed living_cost_source_basis_kind enum.

financial_requirements.administering_body: Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND), the Netherlands
financial_requirements.notes: Migrated from V1.1 CostProfile cp-nl-tu-delft-cse-2026-27-non-eu.estimated_living_costs_annual + living_cost_source_basis (kind=visa_proof_of_funds_deposit), which conflated this immigration liquidity requirement with a living-cost estimate. TU Delft refunds this amount (after deducting permit and housing fees) to the student's own account approximately three weeks after the programme starts -- it is the student's own money, not a genuine cost-of-living estimate.

fields.conflict_detail: Nuffic's own Study in NL page (src-07) did not list TU Delft among participating institutions at the time of this fetch. TU Delft's own scholarships page (src-06), its 2025-2027 scholarships news article (src-09), and a faculty student-portal scholarship page (src-10) mention the Holland Scholarship only in passing metadata or not at all, and list no bachelor's-level scholarships at all -- only two MSc-level scholarships. Deliberately kept at HUMAN_REVIEW / CONFLICT rather than asserted either way. Needs a direct check of TU Delft's admission office or a live (JS-rendered) Study in NL institution filter.

source_records.title: Tuition Fee & Finances
source_records.excerpt: 2026/2027 comparison table: BSc & MSc EU/EFTA tuition EUR 2,694, housing fee EUR 285, total EUR 2,979. BSc non-EU (incl UK) tuition EUR 19,906, living costs EUR 14,200, residence permit/visa fee EUR 254, housing fee EUR 285, total EUR 34,106. 'The Living Costs per year are based on rules of the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND).' 'TU Delft refunds living costs after deducting permit and housing fees to your bank account approximately three weeks following program start.'
